column1: # RECIPE_MEMORY.tsv - append-only lesson memory of recipe four-library-bags-20261106 (RELOCATE_FOUR_LIBRARY_BAGS): one row per lesson, appended in the same commit as the correction.

column4: PATTERN:HASH_PINNED_TEMPLATE_DONOR. A crate whose output was never promoted keeps its postimages only as hash-pinned recipe templates (X.java.txt); the donor's live tree still holds the preimages. Relocate the templates (the crate README calls the recipe the source-changing product) after checking each template's SHA-256 against the crate manifest; the donor type is the file name up to its first dot (Path.stem gives "X.java"), and --donor-subset writes <package path>/X.java so javac accepts them
column5: manifest after-sha256 equal for all 12 templates; first dry read of the v2 code would have named the type "PackedLongBag.java"

column4: PATTERN:BLOCK_LICENSE_HEADER. synexia-common files open with a four-line block header ("/*", " * Copyright 2026 Synexia ...", " * Licensed under ...", " */"); v2's header matcher only knew "// " and "/* " one-line forms, so the block would have stayed under the new M3JDK header. v1 strips a leading block whose inner lines are all Copyright/Licensed/SPDX lines
column5: body_match=TRUE for the five block-header files (M3PackedLongBag, M3PackedLongLongHashMap, M3PackedSupport, M3PackedLongLongMap, M3LongLongPredicate)

column4: PATTERN:CENSUS_NAME_MATCH_IS_NOT_CONTRACT. The census matched LongBag -> M3LongBag as APPLIED_SUPERSET by name; the contracts differ (donor interface: positive amounts, add/remove return the NEW count; master final class: zero allowed, add returns the PREVIOUS count, remove the number removed). Compare the documented contract before accepting a name match; the donor interface is carried under a role name (M3PackedLongBagContract) with an NEC row

PATTERN:ALREADY_ROW. A closure file whose owner is already on master with the same bytes (LongLongConsumer -> M3LongLongConsumer) is neither re-written nor silently assumed: an ALREADY row maps the name (TYPE row), relocate.py relocates it in memory and compares its body with the owner's body after the owner's own header (byte comparison, recorded as ALREADY_BODY_EQUAL in PROVENANCE.tsv), and --donor-subset still writes it so the donor side compiles

a reverse-mapped dump driver is simpler than a reflective one when donor and target differ only by package and type names: one test-scope source (M3FourLibraryBagsDump) is compiled as is for the relocated side and, for the donor side, after sed maps the TYPE rows target->donor and the PACKAGE row back; functional-interface lambdas (M3LongLongConsumer/M3LongLongPredicate) then need no Proxy. Traversal order stays in the dump because both sides run one algorithm
column5: dump IDENTICAL 200,000 ops (18,081,666 bytes), -Xint IDENTICAL 40,000 ops, -Xint == JIT

column4: PATTERN:MASTER_RED_LOCAL_BASELINE_PATCH. Master is red since #2561: M3PrimitiveRoaringIntSet.java:35 missing-explicit-ctor under -Xlint:all,-module -Werror (lane owner's fix pending; the file is a protected owner of another lane). The module gates ran with a local-only patch (one "public M3PrimitiveRoaringIntSet() { }" line, inserted by the gate script and reverted by its EXIT trap) applied identically to base and head, never staged; the compiler warning count is reported for the head tree with that one pre-existing warning removed
column5: base-package.log on unpatched master: 1 warning -> BUILD FAILURE; patched base and head: 0 warnings, BUILD SUCCESS

column4: PATTERN:NAMING_APPLY_STAGES_FOREIGN_FILES. jdk_naming.py apply --only m3/collections/ rewrote and STAGED 54 master files (lineage Javadoc of the synexia-primitives waves: synexia-primitives/... -> m3-primitives/..., RELOCATE_SYNEXIA_OWNER -> RELOCATE_M3_OWNER) that belong to another lane. They were restored (git restore --staged --worktree --pathspec-from-file) and the naming gate is the per-file plan TSV: 0 rows in this recipe's files, and the base tree plan (--tree dbce93c3abf) equals the head plan (54 rows each)
